    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS "sum",

    (COUNT(*) * SUM(l_suppkey * l_extendedprice) - SUM(l_suppkey) * SUM(l_extendedprice))

    DAYOFWEEK(o_orderdate) - 1 AS COL_ALIAS_3
FROM tpch_customer, orders, lineitem
WHERE o_orderkey IN (
    SELECT l_orderkey
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_orderkey
    HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300
)
AND c_custkey = o_custkey
AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice

pg: WITH tipmaterialstatuses AS ( SELECT tso.offer_dept_name AS department , tms.tip_material_status AS status , COUNT( td.tip_material_key ) AS total_tip_materials FROM tip_detail td JOIN tip_subject_offered tso ON td.tip_subject_offered_key = tso.tip_subject_offered_key JOIN tip_material_status tms ON td.tip_material_status_key = tms.tip_material_status_key GROUP BY tso.offer_dept_name , tms.tip_material_status ) , librarymaterialstatuses AS ( SELECT lso.offer_dept_name AS department , lms.library_material_status AS status , COUNT( lrmd.library_reserve_catalog_key ) AS total_library_materials FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd JOIN library_subject_offered lso ON lrmd.library_subject_offered_key = lso.library_subject_offered_key JOIN library_material_status lms ON lrmd.library_material_status_key = lms.library_material_status_key GROUP BY lso.offer_dept_name , lms.library_material_status ) , combinedstatuses AS ( SELECT coalesce( tms.department , lms.department ) AS department , coalesce( tms.status , lms.status ) AS status , COALESCE( tms.total_tip_materials , 0 ) AS total_tip_materials , COALESCE( lms.total_library_materials , 0 ) AS total_library_materials FROM tipmaterialstatuses tms FULL OUTER JOIN librarymaterialstatuses lms ON tms.department = lms.department AND tms.status = lms.status ) SELECT department , status , SUM( total_tip_materials ) AS total_tip_materials , SUM( total_library_materials ) AS total_library_materials , SUM( total_tip_materials + total_library_materials ) AS total_all_materials , SUBSTRING( status FROM 5 FOR 26 ) COL_ALIAS , SUBSTRING( status FROM 4 FOR 28 ) COL_ALIAS_0 , CHAR_LENGTH( department ) COL_ALIAS_1 , SUM(combinedstatuses.total_tip_materials) FILTER(WHERE combinedstatuses.status LIKE '%Course%') COL_ALIAS_2 FROM combinedstatuses GROUP BY ROLLUP ( department , status ) ORDER BY department , status ;

SELECT
    CAST(DATEDIFF(DAY, t1.description, t1.birthday) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS COL_ALIAS,
    t2.ssb + t3.lac AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CONVERT(DATE, '14-SEP-21', 106) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    0.0
FROM patient t1
INNER JOIN laboratory t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
INNER JOIN examination t3 ON t3.id = t2.id
WHERE t2.igg >= 2000
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT_PAIR > 0 
            THEN SUM_X2 - (SUM_X * SUM_X) / COUNT_PAIR 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS DECIMAL(38,2)
    ) AS COL_ALIAS,
    p.product_name,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE),
    CAST(w.warehouse_id AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    CAST(p.product_id AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    CAST(COUNT(o.order_id) AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS DECIMAL(38,2))
FROM inventories i
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
INNER JOIN product_information p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN h_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN p.weight_class IS NOT NULL AND i.quantity_on_hand IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS COUNT_PAIR,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.weight_class IS NOT NULL AND i.quantity_on_hand IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(p.weight_class AS FLOAT) END) AS SUM_X,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.weight_class IS NOT NULL AND i.quantity_on_hand IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(p.weight_class AS FLOAT) * CAST(p.weight_class AS FLOAT) END) AS SUM_X2
) regr
WHERE p.product_status = 'orderable' AND i.quantity_on_hand >= 50
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, p.product_id, p.product_name
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(oi.quantity) AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    p.product_name,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE),
    CAST(COUNT(o.order_id) AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    CAST(p.product_id AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    CAST(w.warehouse_id AS DECIMAL(38,2)),
    0.0
FROM inventories i
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
INNER JOIN product_information p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN h_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.product_status = 'orderable' 
  AND i.quantity_on_hand >= 50
  AND w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/Area') = 1
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, p.product_id, p.product_name
